_comment: Single source of truth for OPT-IN prompt directives (v1.3). POLICY directives (COMMENT_AUDIT, FIGMA, AUTONOMOUS self-review) moved to orca-superpowers-workflow SKILL.md as Principles 7/8/3 — the prompt toggles them with short tokens (AUDIT_OFF_TOKEN, AUTONOMOUS_TOKEN) instead of inlining full text. Run `node build-directives.mjs` to verify panel.html stays in sync.
LOAD_CONTEXT:
First load current workflow context by running:
  orca orchestration run-current --json
  orca orchestration task-list --json
  orca orchestration gate-list --json
If a plan was posted to a Linear issue, read its body too.
If context is incomplete or ambiguous, ask me before proceeding.
POLISH_DIRECTIVE: Pre-step: invoke the prompt-master skill to refine the raw idea above into a sharp feature brief (extract task/input/output/constraints/audience/success criteria; ask up to 3 clarifying questions if intent is ambiguous; output one tight brief). Use that brief as workflow input, not the raw idea.
SIMPLIFY_DIRECTIVE: After each Phase 4 task: invoke the simplify skill on the changed code (reuse/quality/efficiency); fix issues before the next task.
PLAN_ONLY_DIRECTIVE: PLAN-ONLY: run Phase 0 (impact + multi-dim review) + Phase 1 (Linear issue, In Progress) + Phase 2 (brainstorm until all plan-template unknowns resolved). STOP before Phase 3. TEMPLATE AUTO-PICK: >3 sub-features OR >10 tasks → Epic Plan Template (decompose + dep graph + cross-cutting + explore-once → loop depth-first, cap 4 parallel); else 7-section. If unsure decompose, ask. After Phase 2 print "PLAN READY: <ISSUE_ID>" + draft plan for review.
QUICK_FIX_DIRECTIVE: QUICK-FIX: the change meets ALL four canonical Phase 0 skip conditions (see SKILL.md Phase 0 Threshold for the authoritative list — currently: ≤1 file, ≤10 lines, no contract/schema/config/shared-utility, no second-order effects; do NOT duplicate here, refer to SKILL.md). Skip Phase 0/1/2/3 — no impact analysis, no Linear issue, no brainstorm, no plan. Implement directly, verify, commit. If ANY condition fails, STOP and tell me to use the full workflow instead — do NOT force Quick-fix on a change that needs Phase 0. Do NOT create Linear noise for trivial fixes.
SUBAGENT_DIRECTIVE: Multi-dim subagent analysis: spawn <n> subagents (Agent tool), one per dimension round-robin (functional/architecture/data/performance/security/backward-compat/UX/maintenance/operational/business). Each returns assessment + risk + alternative. Synthesize into Phase 0 / Phase 4 gate decision. Read-only — no code writes.
PHASE0_ANALYST_TOKEN: Phase 0 analyst: ON. (MANDATORY dispatch phase0-impact-analyst at Phase 0, even for small changes.)
SPEC_CRITIC_TOKEN: Spec critic: ON. (MANDATORY dispatch spec-critic at the Phase 2→3 gate.)
PLAN_CRITIC_TOKEN: Plan critic: ON. (MANDATORY dispatch plan-critic at the Phase 3→4 gate, even for <5-task plans.)
CODE_REVIEWER_TOKEN: Code review: ON. (MANDATORY dispatch code-reviewer between every Phase 4 task, before gate-resolve.)
VERIFIER_TOKEN: Verifier: ON. (Explicit re-affirm verifier dispatch at Phase 5 — already MANDATORY by default; this token makes intent visible in the prompt.)
SECURITY_AUDIT_TOKEN: Security audit: ON. (Force security-audit dispatch regardless of OWASP-surface auto-detection.)
ROLLBACK_FIXER_TOKEN: Rollback fixer: ON. (Prefer dispatching rollback-fixer agent for ANY rollback, even single-commit Quick-fix reverts; default is inline for small reverts.)
EXECUTE_INLINE_TOKEN: Execute mode: inline — do all Phase 4 tasks yourself, do NOT delegate via worker-start.
EXECUTE_DELEGATE_TOKEN: Execute mode: delegate — prefer `orca orchestration worker-start` for Phase 4 tasks (isolation + concurrency cap). Use inline only for tasks too small to warrant a worker.
EXECUTE_SUPERPOWERS_TOKEN: Execute mode: superpowers — for Phase 4, invoke the `superpowers:executing-plans` skill to drive task execution (it handles its own task loop + verification). Still use `orca orchestration gate-create` for gates between tasks.
_token_coupling: AUDIT_OFF_TOKEN, AUTONOMOUS_TOKEN, EXECUTE_*_TOKEN, and the 4 agent-forcing tokens (PHASE0_ANALYST_TOKEN, SPEC_CRITIC_TOKEN, PLAN_CRITIC_TOKEN, CODE_REVIEWER_TOKEN) are the ONLY wire between this plugin and orca-superpowers-workflow SKILL.md. AUDIT_OFF_TOKEN → Principle 7 opt-out (default ON). AUTONOMOUS_TOKEN → Principle 3 activation (default OFF). EXECUTE_INLINE/DELEGATE/SUPERPOWERS_TOKEN → Phase 4 delegation override (default delegate, table in SKILL.md Delegation section). The 4 agent-forcing tokens → make their respective agent gates MANDATORY regardless of mode/task-size. If you rename any token here, you MUST update the matching trigger phrase in SKILL.md — see Principle 3 'Activation contract', Principle 7 'Opt-out', the Phase 4 Delegation 'Execute-mode token contract' note, and the 4 agent-gate paragraphs (Phase 0 / Phase 2 / Phase 3 / Phase 4 between-tasks). STORY_DIRECTIVE → story checkbox (default OFF); pairs with the Wakii Stories tab (issue-with-subtasks).
STORY_DIRECTIVE: Story mode: ON. Structure the Linear issue as a STORY — after the plan is finalized (Phase 3), create one sub-issue per plan task under the parent issue (via `orca linear create` + `--parent-id`, or `orca linear save-issue` with parent), so the parent issue becomes a trackable story with subtasks. The Stories tab tracks parent-issue progress from these sub-issues. Each sub-issue: title = task title, description = task spec slice, state Todo. Audit-log sub-issue identifiers in the Phase 3 Linear comment.
